svg.title: Laminar and turbulent flow in a blood vessel narrowed by plaque
svg.desc: Blood flows to the right through a vessel that narrows where plaque, hatched, lines its walls. In the wide part the flow is laminar, smooth streamlines moving at speed v1. Entering the narrow part it speeds up to v2, and further on, at the same mean speed v3 = v2, the flow becomes turbulent, full of eddies. In the transition region the flow can oscillate between laminar and turbulent.
